Farm.title: Farm
Farm.description: A sheep herding business workspace owned by an admin with caretaker members.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the farm creator/admin.

name.description: Display name of the sheep farm or business.

memberUids.description: UIDs of all members (admin and caretakers) allowed to read and add entries.

adminUids.description: UIDs of admins allowed to edit/delete entries and manage farm settings.

shepherds.description: List of shepherd (Dharar) names working on the farm.

initialFlockCount.description: Starting number of sheep in the flock.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when farm was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when farm was last updated.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: A financial or livestock transaction entry on a farm (expense, medicine/vet, buy/sell sheep, shepherd advance/salary, or owner funds).

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who logged the entry.

createdByName.description: Display name of the user who logged the entry.

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs from parent farm for list query security.

adminUids.description: Denormalized admin UIDs from parent farm for edit/delete authorization.

livestockCount.description: Number of sheep bought or sold (for LIVESTOCK_BUY or LIVESTOCK_SELL).

shepherdName.description: Name of the shepherd (for SHEPHERD_ADVANCE or SHEPHERD_SALARY).

title.description: Short description or title of the transaction.

receiptBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG bill/receipt image encoded as Base64.

entryDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the transaction date.

FarmInvite.title: FarmInvite
FarmInvite.description: Invite code lookup mapping a 6-12 char join code to a farmId.

ownerId.description: UID of the farm admin who created the invite.

/farms/{farmId}.description: Sheep farm workspaces scoped to memberUids and adminUids.

/farms/{farmId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Ledger transactions belonging to a farm.

/farm_invites/{inviteCode}.description: Direct-get invite code lookup for caretakers joining a farm.
